planets.name: K2-190 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-190 with a 21.6-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-190 c was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-190. Its orbit and size follow Mayo et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
